bundles.title: App shell, API client, global providers, error pages, locale bundles
items:
[HIGH] Topbar does not collapse at 375px: every signed-in page is 583-664px wide and scrolls sideways (both brands, reported by 4 agents)
REPRO: Viewport 375x812, sign in, open /jobs, /settings, /resume, /ready, /applications or /assistant on either brand. Read document.documentElement.scrollWidth.
OBSERVED: scrollWidth 583-643 vs 375. .top-actions spans x~59..598: the 255px search pill ('Search jobs, companies... Cmd-K') stays visible next to the mobile search icon and overlaps the page title; Ask, bell, theme, language and avatar are off-screen. At 1280 both the pill and the icon button show. Same in dark.
EXPECTED: At <=760px the pill is hidden and only the icon button shows; no horizontal page scroll; avatar menu reachable. At desktop only the pill shows.
EVIDENCE: Confirmed in code: Topbar.tsx:69 `className="search max-[760px]:hidden"` and :83 `icon-btn hidden max-[760px]:grid` are Tailwind v4 layered utilities, while `.search{display:flex}` / `.icon-btn{display:grid}` (styles/v3.css:208,235; styles/workspace.css:85-89) are imported unlayered in app/globals.css:3,9, so the unlayered rules always win. Screens: .verify/ra-jobs-tracker/36-mobile-jobs-vp.png, .verify/goapply/shots/m375-app_jobs.png. After the fix re-measure: smaller residual overflows were also seen on the /jobs chip row (right=405), settings section nav (451) and practice category chip (381) - those belong to G3/G2/G6.
LIKELY FILES: components/v3/shell/Topbar.tsx, styles/v3.css, styles/workspace.css, app/globals.css, components/v3/shell/shell.module.css

[HIGH] API client turns an envelope with data:null into the envelope object; /jobs/report crashes for every user with no report (both brands, 3 agents)
REPRO: Sign in as a user who never ran the competitiveness report. Open /jobs/report (or click 'You and what employers ask' on /jobs).
OBSERVED: Error boundary replaces the page; console 'IntlError: FORMATTING_ERROR: Invalid time value at ReportPage'. GET /match/competitiveness/latest returns {success:true,data:null}; the page receives the whole envelope as the report and calls format.dateTime(new Date(undefined)). 'Try again' repeats the crash. The error boundary text is English on zh pages.
EXPECTED: An envelope with data:null unwraps to null, so the page shows its start state with the run button. Applies to every endpoint that may return data:null.
EVIDENCE: Confirmed: lib/api/client.ts:385 `return (data?.data ?? data) as T;` - nullish coalescing falls back to the envelope. Fix by detecting the envelope ('success' in data / 'data' in data) instead of `??`. Screens: .verify/ra-jobs-tracker/33--jobs-report.png, .verify/goapply/shots/jobs-report-crash.png.
LIKELY FILES: lib/api/client.ts, app/error.tsx

[MEDIUM] All client-formatted times use the brand default time zone (UTC on RoboApply), not the viewer's
REPRO: Machine in UTC+8 at 02:55 on Oct 11. Use up tailoring credits; open a resume check report; open a cover letter's Versions tab; open the out-of-credits sheet.
OBSERVED: 'None left today. More on Oct 11' (it already is Oct 11), 'Wait until 12:00 AM' (real refill 08:00 local), 'Checked Oct 10, 2026, 6:08 PM' for a check run at 02:08 Oct 11, letter versions 'Oct 10, 7:06 PM'; other surfaces that format locally say Oct 11.
EXPECTED: Times in the viewer's time zone, consistently (or the zone is stated).
EVIDENCE: Confirmed: app/providers.tsx:108-109 passes `timeZone={brand.defaultTimezone}` to NextIntlClientProvider; lib/brand/registry.generated.ts:157 is 'UTC' for RoboApply (Asia/Shanghai for GoApply). Every format.dateTime call inherits it. Screens: .verify/ra-resume-letters/shots/31-out-of-credits.png, 11-check-report-1280.png, 43-versions.png. Mind SSR/hydration when switching to the browser zone.
LIKELY FILES: app/providers.tsx

[LOW] 404 and error pages: React 'script tag' console error, English-only text, only 'Go to Jobs' for signed-out visitors
REPRO: Open /no-such-page signed out and signed in (/onboarding/bogus); repeat on goapply.localhost with zh.
OBSERVED: Console: 'Encountered a script tag while rendering React component' on every 404 (3 agents). Page text 'That page does not exist ... Go to Jobs' in English with html lang=zh; no site header; the only action sends a visitor to /login?next=/jobs. app/error.tsx text is hard-coded English.
EXPECTED: Clean console; localized 404 and error text; a home link for visitors.
EVIDENCE: public2.out log lines; .verify/goapply/shots/m375-404.png; shots/pub2-no-such-page-claude-verify-1280.png.
LIKELY FILES: app/not-found.tsx, app/error.tsx, app/global-error.tsx, i18n/staging/errors.en.json

[LOW] Locale bundle leftovers in zh / zh-TW / ja
REPRO: Set language to zh-TW or ja and open /jobs and a job detail; open /applications board; on GoApply open /settings.
OBSERVED: zh-TW mixes half-width colon and curly quotes ('缺少的地方: ...', '來自職缺說明: "..."') with full-width forms elsewhere; normalized location 'Anywhere' stays English; board column aria-label 'Applied, 1 jobs' (no plural); API copy 'Up to 1 saved searches on this plan'; /en landing on GoApply has a Chinese <title> and most app pages are titled only with the brand name.
EXPECTED: Consistent full-width punctuation in zh-TW, translated 'Anywhere', ICU plurals.
EVIDENCE: s35.cjs zh-TW and ja dumps; screenshots 35-zh-TW-detail-1280.png, 35-ja-jobs-1280.png. Bundle-only edits; if a string turns out to be server-produced, hand it to the owning group.
LIKELY FILES: i18n/messages/zh-TW.json, i18n/messages/ja.json, i18n/messages/zh.json, i18n/messages/en.json

[LOW] Avatar shows the literal placeholder 'RA' until /auth/me returns (also on GoApply)
REPRO: Reload any signed-in page on goapply.localhost and watch the avatar while /auth/me is pending.
OBSERVED: Avatar reads 'RA' (RoboApply initials) for several seconds, then 'UU' for a nameless phone user.
EXPECTED: A neutral placeholder (icon or skeleton), not another brand's initials.
EVIDENCE: Confirmed: components/v3/shell/AvatarMenu.tsx:43 `if (!src) return 'RA';`. Screen .verify/goapply/shots/practice-setup.png.
LIKELY FILES: components/v3/shell/AvatarMenu.tsx

bundles.namespace: accountV2, auth, growth, invite, onboarding, profile, settings
items:
[HIGH] Onboarding writes 'Anywhere in {country}' as a zero-radius location row, so a new user's saved search matches remote jobs only or nothing (3 agents)
REPRO: New account. Basics: title 'Software engineer' (or 'Product Designer'), Full-time, United States, leave 'Anywhere in United States' (no city). Finish onboarding, open /jobs.
OBSERVED: Saved search gets locations:[{label:'US',country:'US',radiusKm:0}] plus country:'US'. Feed returns 7 remote-only jobs (0 for Product Designer; confirm says 'We didn't find strong fits yet') although the snapshot said '63 open roles ... in United States'. Removing the 'US - Same city' chip gives 54 jobs.
EXPECTED: 'Anywhere in {country}' stores only the country (no locations entry), so every job in that country shows.
EVIDENCE: Confirmed: server/src/features/onboarding/mapping.ts:90-94 maps city-less countries to `{label: c, country: c, radiusKm: 0}`. Screens .verify/ra-jobs-tracker/09-jobs-foryou-1280-tall.png, 15-foryou-no-location-tall.png. Existing profiles that already carry the row are handled by the G3 finding on the feed predicate.
LIKELY FILES: server/src/features/onboarding/mapping.ts, server/src/features/onboarding/mapping.test.ts

[HIGH] Confirm headline 'We found N jobs that fit you - counts jobs at Good fit or better' is not a fit count; it flips between numbers and shows 1,586 for a user with no resume (D3)
REPRO: A) Urgent path with resume: reach /onboarding/confirm, read the h1, reload. B) Skip every step including resume and reach confirm.
OBSERVED: A) 62, then 30 after reload, then 62 again. B) 'We didn't find strong fits yet' for ~3 s, then 'We found 1,586 jobs that fit you' although matching compared 0 jobs. POST /search-profiles/count returns the same number with fitTier good, great or absent.
EXPECTED: One stable number that really is the count at Good fit or better (from the onboarding match result), or wording 'jobs match your search'; never called a fit when no resume was compared.
EVIDENCE: Confirmed: ConfirmStep.tsx:76-78 uses `useFilterCount({...filters, fitTier:'good'})` and falls back to matched.jobCount; server/src/features/feed/sql.ts:315 treats fitTier as view-only (never SQL), so the count is the unfiltered search size. Fix inside this group: take the count from the onboarding match result (match.ts) and change the wording when nothing was compared. Screens shots/06-confirm-initial-1280.png, shots/15-skip-confirm-1280.png.
LIKELY FILES: components/features/onboarding/steps/ConfirmStep.tsx, server/src/features/onboarding/match.ts, server/src/features/onboarding/contract.ts, i18n/staging/onboarding.en.json

[HIGH] First-visit tour never appears and onboarding stays at stage 'tour' (popup gate drops the grant when the mount effect runs twice)
REPRO: Finish /onboarding/confirm with 'Show my jobs' -> /jobs. Wait 15 s, reload, wait again.
OBSERVED: No dialog; /auth/me.onboarding stays {step:'tour', completed:false}; POST /onboarding/complete never fires; the tips dock that needs completed=true never unlocks.
EXPECTED: The 4-card overlay shows once; Start or close moves the stage to done. The gate must grant a key again when the same requester re-asks inside the arbitration window.
EVIDENCE: Confirmed in lib/ui/popupGate.ts: decide() (line 111-142) resolves one winner per batch; usePopupGate (line 241-248) sets live=false on cleanup, so under React strict mode (next.config.mjs reactStrictMode) the first request wins with live=false and the second request of the same key is resolved false. Agent's browser-side patch granting the second request showed the tour and completed onboarding. Likely dev-only, but any effect re-run inside the window loses the grant; verify on a production build too. Screens shots/07-jobs-tour-1280.png, shots/08-tour-1280-light.png.
LIKELY FILES: lib/ui/popupGate.ts, components/features/onboarding/TourOverlay.tsx

[MEDIUM] A late background 'onboarding.match' queue job overwrote the user's edited saved search with the onboarding answers (likely cause)
REPRO: Close the tab during onboarding step 'Finding jobs' (server queues onboarding.match from phase 'saving'). Reopen, finish onboarding, edit the main search (Clear all). Wait for queue-drain to reach the item.
OBSERVED: After Clear all (profile version 29->30) the next load showed version 31 with exactly the onboarding answers and no client write; a queue-drain run started in between.
EXPECTED: A background onboarding match never rewrites a saved search after onboarding completed or after the profile version moved (skip the 'saving' phase).
EVIDENCE: s38.cjs / s39.cjs logs; logs/all-2026-10-10.jsonl 'queue-drain complete' 19:13:51Z. server/src/features/onboarding/workers.ts runs runOnboardingMatch whose 'saving' phase calls applyAnswers. Not reproduced a second time, so treat the queue job as the probable writer and add a guard plus a test.
LIKELY FILES: server/src/features/onboarding/workers.ts, server/src/features/onboarding/match.ts, server/src/features/onboarding/service.ts

[MEDIUM] Profile stays 0% complete after onboarding with a full resume
REPRO: Onboard by uploading a resume with name, email, phone, city, education, three jobs and skills. Open /ready/setup step 1, a kit, and the People tab.
OBSERVED: 'Complete your profile - 0% complete': all nine groups missing; the kit lists nine missing details; People says 'Add past jobs to your profile'; kit file name has no person name. Onboarding did parse the data (resume name, suggested skills).
EXPECTED: Profile fields prefilled from the parsed resume for the user to confirm (the step is titled 'Confirm your profile'); profile has a sync-from-resume diff/apply that onboarding should call.
EVIDENCE: shots/ready-setup-step2.png, job-people-tab.png; /agent/setup checks.profileMissing.
LIKELY FILES: server/src/features/onboarding/service.ts, server/src/features/profile/

[MEDIUM] Settings > Account: 'Full name' shows the email and is read-only; experience shows 'New graduate'; LinkedIn accepts 'not a url'; pronoun options are English in zh
REPRO: Sign up by email (no name field), upload a resume with 8 years of experience, open /settings#account. Type 'not a url' in LinkedIn and save. Repeat on GoApply in zh.
OBSERVED: Full name = the email address, input readonly, initials from the address; resume name unused; 'Years of experience: New graduate'; LinkedIn value 'not a url' persists; pronouns 'she/her', 'he/him', 'they/them' in a Chinese screen.
EXPECTED: Empty or real name, editable; experience prefilled or unset; the same linkedin.com/in validation as onboarding; localized pronoun options.
EVIDENCE: Confirmed: components/v3/preferences/sections/IdentitySection.tsx:67 `<TextInput value={name} readOnly .../>`; settings/page.tsx:227 falls back to email. Screens shots/20-settings-1280-light.png, shots/22-account-edited.png, .verify/goapply/shots/settings-1280.png.
LIKELY FILES: app/(auth)/settings/page.tsx, components/v3/preferences/sections/IdentitySection.tsx, i18n/staging/settings.en.json

[MEDIUM] Job-title typeahead is English-only: zh-TW/ja get English labels and Chinese input finds nothing
REPRO: Language zh-TW. GET /onboarding/title-suggest?q=後端&locale=zh-TW, then q=backend&locale=zh-TW.
OBSERVED: q=後端 -> items []. q=backend -> 'Backend and platform' / 'Software engineering' in English for zh-TW and ja.
EXPECTED: Localized role labels and matching on localized input for the Taiwan/Japan audiences.
EVIDENCE: A locale-aware label already exists: server/src/features/jobs/taxonomy/taxonomy.ts:118 `taxonomyLabel(id, locale)` (used by the feed with `?? c.en`); the onboarding suggest path (server/src/features/onboarding/defaults.ts:114 suggestTitles, routes.ts:117) does not use it. If the taxonomy data lacks zh-TW/ja labels, request them from G3 (owner of server/src/features/jobs/taxonomy).
LIKELY FILES: server/src/features/onboarding/defaults.ts, server/src/features/onboarding/routes.ts, server/src/features/onboarding/service.ts, components/features/onboarding/steps/TitlePicker.tsx

[MEDIUM] Two floating prompts at once on /jobs after 'Finish later': Assistant nudge sits under the 'Finish setting up' banner
REPRO: New account -> /onboarding/situation -> 'Finish later' -> /jobs, wait ~10 s (1280 or 375).
OBSERVED: The pay nudge card and the 'Finish setting up - 5 steps left' banner both appear bottom-right; the banner covers the nudge's primary button, and at 375 both cover checklist rows.
EXPECTED: Never two prompts at once (PRODUCT O8); the banner goes through the popup gate or reserves its own space.
EVIDENCE: shots/15-jobs-finish-banner-1280.png, 15-jobs-finish-banner-375.png. The finish banner renders outside the popup gate while the nudge uses usePopupGate('assistant:nudge').
LIKELY FILES: components/features/onboarding/FirstVisitPrompts.tsx, components/features/onboarding/onboarding.module.css, lib/ui/popupGate.ts

[MEDIUM] Uploading a PDF before the consent query finishes blames 'the reading option you turned off'
REPRO: Open /onboarding/resume while the API is slow and choose a PDF within ~4 s of load.
OBSERVED: 'This PDF can't be read without the reading option you turned off...' although the user never declined anything; the same upload works 8 s later.
EXPECTED: Wait for the consent state (or say 'still loading, try again') instead of blaming a setting.
EVIDENCE: Confirmed: ResumeStep.tsx:149 `if (isPdfFile(file) && !pdfOpen) return setProblem('pdfNeedsConsent');` - pdfOpen is false while the consent query is still loading.
LIKELY FILES: components/features/onboarding/steps/ResumeStep.tsx

[MEDIUM] GET /auth/me returns internal token fields (passwordResetToken, emailVerificationToken) in the user object
REPRO: Signed in on either brand: curl /api/v1/roboapply/auth/me with the session cookie and read data.user.
OBSERVED: data.user carries passwordResetToken / emailVerificationToken keys (null in the test account).
EXPECTED: /me returns only public user fields; token columns are never serialized, even hashed.
EVIDENCE: Confirmed: server/src/roboapply/routes/auth.ts:565 returns `user: req.user` unfiltered. Strip the fields in this handler (the auth middleware that builds req.user is outside this group; request a follow-up if it should be fixed at the source).
LIKELY FILES: server/src/roboapply/routes/auth.ts

[MEDIUM] Account deletion (GoApply): reason silently required, promises a confirmation email, asks a Chinese user to type 'DELETE'; security note prints the raw provider id 'phone'
REPRO: goapply.localhost /settings#danger -> 删除账号 -> type the confirmation -> submit with 原因 empty. Open /settings#security as a phone user.
OBSERVED: Nothing is sent; an inline '请告诉我们你为什么要离开' appears though the field is not marked required. Dialog says '我们会给你发一封确认邮件' while email is off and phone users have no address. Security: '你用 phone 登录，所以没有密码可以修改。'
EXPECTED: Reason optional or clearly marked; no email promise when notify.email is off; localized provider name (手机号); a localized confirmation word.
EVIDENCE: .verify/goapply/shots/delete-account-dialog.png, delete-account-after-click.png, settings-security.png; i18n zh settings.oauthNote receives the raw provider id.
LIKELY FILES: components/v3/account/, components/v3/preferences/sections/DangerSection.tsx, i18n/staging/settings.en.json

[LOW] Onboarding validation errors stay on screen after the field is fixed
REPRO: Basics: click Next empty, then add titles and pick a country. Preferences: enter pay 'abc', Next, then type 1,200,000.
OBSERVED: 'Add at least one job title.', 'Pick at least one place.', 'Enter an amount above 0...' and 'Pick up to 3 titles.' remain until Next is pressed again.
EXPECTED: Each error clears when its field becomes valid.
EVIDENCE: shots/05-basics-ready-1280-dark.png, shots/13-preferences-375-dark.png.
LIKELY FILES: components/features/onboarding/steps/BasicsStep.tsx, components/features/onboarding/steps/PreferencesStep.tsx, components/features/onboarding/steps/TitlePicker.tsx

[LOW] Settings headings have broken spacing ('The one-waybuttons.', 'looking for .', stray spaces in CJK) and the section nav overflows at 375px
REPRO: Open /settings#danger and /settings#search in en, zh-TW and ja; open /settings at 375px.
OBSERVED: 'The one-waybuttons.'; 'Tell us what you're looking for .'; zh-TW '關於 你自己。', '這些是 無法復原的按鈕。'; ja '取り消せない 操作。'. Section nav extends to x=451 at 375.
EXPECTED: Correct English spacing, no inserted spaces in CJK (join lead/accent without a hard-coded space), nav scrolls inside its own container.
EVIDENCE: DangerSection.tsx:71 joins title_em + title_after with no space; HuntSection.tsx:37 adds a space before '.'. shots/21-settings-danger-1280-light.png, out-23.txt.
LIKELY FILES: components/v3/preferences/sections/DangerSection.tsx, components/v3/preferences/sections/HuntSection.tsx, components/v3/preferences/sections/IdentitySection.tsx, styles/v3-preferences.css

[LOW] Truncated reset link shows the weak-password error; truncated verify link shows a network error
REPRO: Open /reset-password/bogus-token-123, enter a valid password, save. Open /verify-email/bogus-token-123.
OBSERVED: Reset: all rules ticked yet 'Use at least 8 characters...' (API 422 invalid_request for token length). Verify: 'Something went wrong. Check your connection and try again.'
EXPECTED: 'This link is not valid' with the request-a-new-link action in both cases.
EVIDENCE: shots/10-reset-bogus.png, shots/10-verify-bogus.png; PasswordResetViews maps invalid_request to signupForm.weakPassword.
LIKELY FILES: components/features/auth/PasswordResetViews.tsx, components/features/auth/VerifyEmailView.tsx

[LOW] Settings > Invite friends intermittently shows 'This section did not load' with no retry
REPRO: Open /settings#referrals repeatedly under load (2 of ~12 loads).
OBSERVED: Section error fallback, no retry button, no failed request captured (probably a slow /invites call).
EXPECTED: Loading state then content, or an inline retry.
EVIDENCE: out-23.txt, out-25.txt, shots/25-settings-referrals-1280-dark.png.
LIKELY FILES: components/features/growth/SettingsSection.tsx, components/features/settings/SettingsPage.tsx

[LOW] Market snapshot shows skills lower-case ('python, aws, ci/cd')
REPRO: Onboarding basics: pick 'Backend and platform' + United States.
OBSERVED: 'Most requested skills: python, aws, java, kubernetes, ci/cd, react'.
EXPECTED: Display casing (Python, AWS, CI/CD).
EVIDENCE: shots/05-basics-snapshot-1280.png.
LIKELY FILES: server/src/features/onboarding/snapshot.ts, components/features/onboarding/steps/MarketSnapshotPanel.tsx

[LOW] Auth page polish: doubled email error, theme icon convention differs from the app header, GoApply auth panel promises a talking interview
REPRO: /signup with email 'bad' -> submit. Compare the theme button on /signup and /onboarding. Open goapply.localhost/signup.
OBSERVED: 'Enter a valid email address.' appears under the field and again in the red box. Auth pages show the target-theme icon, the app header the current one (both labelled 'Switch to dark'). GoApply panel says '会跟你对话的练习面试' although voice is unavailable there. The analytics banner overlaps 'Already have an account? Sign in' at 1280x900 (banner component is owned by G8).
EXPECTED: One error message, one icon convention, brand-true claims.
EVIDENCE: shots/02-signup-invalid-email.png, shots/27-signup-1280-dark.png, .verify/goapply/shots/pub_signup-1280.png.
LIKELY FILES: components/features/auth/AuthEntryView.tsx, components/auth/methods/registry.ts, components/auth/AuthShell.tsx

bundles.title: Feed, filters, fit scoring, job detail, job data, tracker, alerts, people
bundles.namespace: applications, filters, fit, inbox, jobDetail, jobImport, jobs, jobsCn, people, taxonomy
items:
[HIGH] Feed treats a country-only location entry (radius 0) as 'same city': only remote jobs pass, chip reads 'US - Same city', zero-results shows 'undefined - Within NaN mi'
REPRO: Use a saved search containing locations:[{label:'US',country:'US',radiusKm:0}] (every account onboarded with 'Anywhere in United States' has it). Open /jobs; open the Work model sheet to trigger the zero-results suggestions.
OBSERVED: Feed returns remote/anywhere jobs only (7, vs 54 after removing the chip). Chips show 'United States' and 'US - Same city' (zh-TW 'US - 同一城市'); the suggestion row reads 'Remove Locations: undefined - Within NaN mi'.
EXPECTED: A location entry with a country and no city means the whole country (no city predicate); it renders as one localized 'Anywhere in United States' chip; the zero-results suggestion shows a readable label. Existing profiles must work without a data migration.
EVIDENCE: server/src/features/feed/sql.ts locationSql (lines ~143-155) compares locationCity when radiusKm is 0; components/features/filters/useFilterLabels.ts:53 renders km===0 as options.radiusSameCity and uses the raw code as label. Screens .verify/ra-jobs-tracker/14-workmodel-hybrid.png, shots/a2-filter-diff-proposed.png. The writer is fixed in G2 (onboarding mapping).
LIKELY FILES: server/src/features/feed/sql.ts, server/src/features/feed/sql.test.ts, components/features/filters/useFilterLabels.ts, components/features/feed/ZeroResults.tsx, i18n/staging/filters.en.json

[HIGH] Quick-estimate fit score is not honest: 100/100 'Great fit' when the post states no skills, changes with the Level filter, rates unrelated jobs Great, and differs between feed, Similar jobs and alerts (3 reports)
REPRO: A) Senior Product Designer resume, search Full-time + United States: open /ready/setup step 2 or the feed. B) 8-year engineer resume: note scores with Level=Senior, remove the chip, add Mid level, compare the same jobs; compare Similar jobs on a detail page with the feed cards.
OBSERVED: A) Top three are cleared-engineer postings with fit {tier:'great', score:100, kind:'pre', topGap:null, topOverlap:null}; the one real Product Designer job is 'possible' 61. B) Same job 100 -> 84 -> 74 (AI) as the Level chips change; internship and junior roles 'Great fit 84' for a senior resume while 'Senior Software Engineer (Python)' is 'Possible 59'; Similar jobs shows 91 / 87 where the feed shows 73 / 59; an alert stored tier 'good' where the feed shows 'Possible 59'.
EXPECTED: One score per user and job on every surface (the AI score when it exists). The pre-score reflects the resume, not which Level chips are selected; a job whose components are mostly 'not stated' cannot reach Great/100 (cap or lower confidence); roles two levels below the resume are not Great.
EVIDENCE: Confirmed design in server/src/features/match/preScore.ts:21 'A not_stated component drops out and the remaining weights renormalize' and seniority scored against the search's target levels (unknown = 0.8). Feed JSON with explanation.gaps notStated.* and score 100; screens 09-jobs-foryou-1280-tall.png, 17-detail-tab-people.png, shots/ready-setup-calibrate-rated.png.
LIKELY FILES: server/src/features/match/preScore.ts, server/src/features/match/preScore.test.ts, server/src/features/feed/ranking.ts, server/src/features/feed/FeedQueryService.ts, components/features/job/SimilarJobs.tsx, server/src/features/alerts/

[MEDIUM] A second filter change made before the first PATCH returns gets 409 version_conflict and is dropped; no pending state
REPRO: On /jobs remove a filter chip (or pick a tier). Within the 2-5 s the PATCH takes, apply another filter or click another tier.
OBSERVED: Controls do not change until the PATCH returns and show no saving state. The second change is sent with the same baseVersion -> 409; the choice is lost and the filter sheet stays open.
EXPECTED: Optimistic update or a visible saving state, with consecutive changes queued/retried on the new version so none is lost.
EVIDENCE: s12.cjs (PATCH baseVersion 9 twice -> 409), s14.cjs; screen 12-tier-good.png.
LIKELY FILES: hooks/search/, components/features/filters/FilterBar.tsx, components/features/filters/FitTierFilter.tsx, components/features/filters/ActiveFilterChips.tsx

[MEDIUM] Absurd or non-pay text is shown as pay ('$60,000,000-$90,000,000 an hour'; 'Pay as stated: Competitive Pay and Benefits...')
REPRO: Open /jobs (Software engineer, United States) and find 'Jr. Software Developer' at iCatalyst; open a detail page and read Similar jobs (Miratech).
OBSERVED: API pay {min:60000000,max:90000000,period:'hour'} from '$60,000K-$90,000K'; it also sorts near the top for 'Highest pay'. A tile shows a benefits sentence as 'Pay as stated'.
EXPECTED: Pay outside a plausible range for its period is not shown as a number (and is excluded from pay sort); 'Pay as stated' only shows text that contains an amount.
EVIDENCE: s15.cjs / s21.cjs listings; curl /jobs/cmv2p5vyji9baxcia8jwn4bih.
